review_locator: PMCID:PMC11402718, Unveiling the contribution of tumor-associated macrophages in driving epithelial-mesenchymal transition: a review of mechanisms and therapeutic Strategies; PMCID:PMC9693759, Cutting edges and therapeutic opportunities on tumor-associated macrophages in lung cancer
primary_title: Macrophage CCL22 expression promotes lymphangiogenesis in patients with tongue squamous cell carcinoma via IL-4/STAT6 in the tumor microenvironment
decision_basis: The reviews identify CCL22 as an IL-4/STAT6-regulated macrophage chemokine; the cited primary shows a STAT6-site-mutated CCL22 promoter loses IL-4 responsiveness and STAT6 inhibition reduces CCL22 protein in human macrophage systems.
limitations_preserved: Promoter-site mutation and inhibitor data support a bounded IL-4/STAT6-to-CCL22 gene bridge in human macrophage/TAM models; distinguish CCL22 transcript/promoter activity from secreted CCL22 protein and downstream CCR4 signaling, and do not infer SCI or terminal-TF output.

primary_title: Murine eotaxin-2: a constitutive eosinophil chemokine induced by allergen challenge and IL-4 overexpression
decision_basis: The review identifies CCL24/eotaxin-2 as a STAT6-regulated type-2-response gene; the cited primary shows IL-4- and allergen-associated Ccl24 mRNA induction in mouse lung is lost in STAT6-deficient IL-4 transgenic mice.
limitations_preserved: STAT6-dependent IL-4-associated Ccl24 induction supports a bounded mouse lung gene bridge; source cell and IL-4-versus-IL-13 contributions are unresolved, and transcript induction does not automatically establish secretion, CCR3 signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF output.
